text:
ConocoPhillips jumped 2.6% today after the company reported third-quarter earnings showing $4 billion in net income on Thursday. The stock had been hammered over the prior week—dropping nearly 10% from late October highs—but today's solid earnings result and the release of its full quarterly financials appear to have halted the selling momentum and attracted some buying back in.

The recovery also fits a moment of relative stability in oil markets after recent turbulence. US crude is trading around $100 per barrel, while the wider energy sector is wrestling with mixed signals: offshore wind and solar could benefit from the new political landscape, but oil majors are watching geopolitical risks and price uncertainty. A profitable quarter and visible cash generation likely reassured investors that ConocoPhillips can weather this uncertain environment.
